title: Regression: Changed needed to support new change for `show int stat` to perform `rexec -c "..." all`
author: Javier-Tan
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Previous Working Version

Before https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-utilities/pull/4529 was added

### Steps to Reproduce

Any test that could run `show int stat` on supervisor

### Impact of this regression

Causes test failures where due to `rc!=0` for `show int stat` on supervisor (when not accoutning for new https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-utilities/pull/4529).

### Relevant log output

```shell
test_pretest.py::test_update_testbed_metadata

    return fn(*fn_args, **fn_kwargs)
           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/var/src/sonic-mgmt/tests/test_pretest.py", line 78, in collect_dut_info
    status = dut.show_interface(command='status')['ansible_facts']['int_status']
             ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/var/src/sonic-mgmt/tests/common/devices/multi_asic.py", line 386, in _run_on_asics_wrapper
    return self._run_on_asics(attr, *module_args, **complex_args)
           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/var/src/sonic-mgmt/tests/common/devices/multi_asic.py", line 158, in _run_on_asics
    return getattr(self.sonichost, multi_asic_attr)(*module_args, **complex_args)
           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/var/src/sonic-mgmt/tests/common/devices/base.py", line 163, in _run_wrapper
    return self._run(module_name, *module_args, **kwargs)
           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/var/src/sonic-mgmt/tests/common/devices/base.py", line 248, in _run
    raise RunAnsibleModuleFail("run module {} failed".format(module_name), hostname_res)
```
